index.html.meta.title: FinDera Consulting — Your connection to sustainable solutions in Europe
index.html.meta.desc: FinDera connects Finnish projects and organisations with the right sites, people and practical lessons across Europe. Site visits, group trips, door opening and mapping — with special expertise in Germany and the DACH region.
index.html.hero.title: Your connection tosustainable Europe.
index.html.hero.lead: FinDera connects projects and organisations with the best best-practices, expertise and practical lessons in Europe.
index.html.intro.title: It all centres on people meeting people.
index.html.intro.lead: Genuine interaction and hands-on experience create deeper understanding of sustainable solutions than any report.
index.html.intro.p1: I open the doors according to your objective — as site visits, meetings and mapping — distil the essential lessons and take those encounters towards concrete impact, no matter if we speak of energy, circular economy or other sustainable development related solutions.
index.html.intro.p2: The result is always a rewarding, pleasant and memorable experience for everyone involved -with a human touch.
index.html.svc.title: Three ways to move forward.
index.html.svc.lead: I help organisations find the right solutions, best practices and partners in Europe — and turn them into concrete encounters and knowledge exchange.
index.html.svc1.title: Site visits and group trips

index.html.svc1.desc: Trips are designed around your objectives for expert and management teams: a tailored programme on a workable schedule, usually with me as tour leader.
index.html.svc1.li1: Sites selected according to your objectives
index.html.svc1.li2: Confirmed meetings and a ready agenda
index.html.svc1.li3: Pacing, facilitation, tour leadership and interpreting
index.html.svc2.title: First contact and meetings
index.html.svc2.when: When you are looking for partners or planning market entry.
index.html.svc2.desc: I identify the right players, arrange the meetings and build a coherent basis for the discussions — so that the exchange supports decision-making.

index.html.svc2.li2: Agreed meetings and a prepared discussion outline

index.html.svc3.li2: A reasoned shortlist to support decision-making
index.html.svc3.li3: Introductions and contact brokering where agreed
index.html.why.title: Dependable quality in knowledge and contacts.
index.html.why.lead: Long experience means I recognise the solutions that work and can pick the sites that genuinely benefit you — while making sure the encounters are well run and worth the time. Progress stays controlled, purposeful and productive.
index.html.why.1.title: Precise scoping and targeting
index.html.why.1.desc: I define the criteria together with you and quickly identify the most relevant solutions, sites and players.
index.html.why.2.title: Relationships with the right people
index.html.why.2.desc: I turn contacts into concrete encounters and make sure each discussion has a clear objective and structure.
index.html.why.3.title: Comparable practical understanding
index.html.why.3.desc: I distil what works in practice and under what conditions — to support your decision-making.
index.html.why.4.title: Impact and next steps
index.html.why.4.desc: I take the work towards the next stage: a draft decision, a pilot, a partnership path or a clear roadmap.
index.html.why.5.title: A rare perspective
index.html.why.5.desc: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties.
index.html.why.6.title: Track record and networks
index.html.why.6.desc: Over 70 trips delivered and some 1,300 participants, plus a broad working network across Europe, particularly in the DACH region — including market entries for Finnish companies.
index.html.quote.1.text: FinDera delivered the trip for our management team and board very smoothly on a turnkey basis. The trip provided valuable shared time, new perspectives and strengthened our common view of developing the company.
index.html.quote.2.text: Martin planned the trip largely on a turnkey basis while still taking our wishes into account. During the trip he was an invaluable guide, tour leader and interpreter, which made the whole thing successful and effortless.
index.html.quote.3.text: FinDera built an excellent package at board level: relevant sites, well-prepared meetings and smooth arrangements. We gained a valuable knowledge base to support investment decisions.

palvelut.html.p1.desc2: When you want to see sustainable solutions in practice and build a shared understanding of them, a site visit is the most effective way to learn. The sites can be elsewhere in Europe or here in Finland.

palvelut.html.pwhy.title: Encounters that land, lessons that last.
palvelut.html.pwhy.lead: At its best, what a trip yields keeps paying off long after everyone has gone home. Five things set the work apart.
palvelut.html.pwhy.1.title: A grasp of the subject
palvelut.html.pwhy.1.desc: I can connect the themes and find the one site that is genuinely worth visiting. Sustainability, energy, the circular economy and the environment are the core of my work.
palvelut.html.pwhy.2.title: Opening doors
palvelut.html.pwhy.2.desc: I secure meetings with the right people and with the right agenda.
palvelut.html.pwhy.3.title: Reliable delivery
palvelut.html.pwhy.3.desc: A rhythm that works, realistic logistics, smooth running and good group dynamics.
palvelut.html.pwhy.4.title: A multi-stakeholder view
palvelut.html.pwhy.4.desc: It comes from a career spanning the private sector, the public sector and central government.
palvelut.html.pwhy.5.title: Tour leadership and a good atmosphere
palvelut.html.pwhy.5.desc: Smooth execution, good spirit, and a trip participants remember.
palvelut.html.pwhy.note: The hardest work and the real risk are not in the itinerary on paper. They are in the quality of the sites, in getting the meetings confirmed, in a rhythm that holds, and in whether the visits genuinely serve the objective. Get those right and the trip produces insights, contacts and concrete next steps.
palvelut.html.p2.desc2: When the aim is to find partners, map out opportunities for collaboration or benchmark solutions to support a decision, I build you a set of meetings where the right people and the right agenda come together.

projektit.html.meta.title: Projects and references — FinDera Consulting
projektit.html.meta.desc: Examples of study and benchmarking trips delivered by FinDera: Turku UAS, Rosk'n Roll, OSAO, Seinäjoen Energia, LADEC, Salpakierto, Salaojayhdistys, the ELY Centre and Lounais-Suomen Jätehuolto.
projektit.html.ph.title: Examples of deliveries.
projektit.html.ph.lead: More than 70 study and benchmarking trips on sustainability across Europe, with some 1,300 Finnish experts taking part in total. Here are a few examples.
projektit.html.case.turkuamk.desc: Innovative stormwater and greywater solutions and how they are implemented in Finland.
projektit.html.case.turkuamk.role: FinDera's role: designing and scheduling the programme, identifying the sites and confirming the visits and restaurants, coordinating and assisting with travel logistics, and providing remote support during the trip.
projektit.html.case.turkuamk.more:
Participants: specialists from the university of applied sciences, eight people in all.

Content: innovative stormwater and greywater solutions and their implementations in Finland. Four sites over two days.
projektit.html.case.rr.desc: A full-scale vertical farming benchmark site linked to the company's development project.
projektit.html.case.rr.role: FinDera's role: identifying the site, confirming the visit and fitting it into the travel programme, including coordination of logistics.
projektit.html.case.lsjh.desc: Reuse as a central part of the future economy and sustainable business. Sites included UpcycleCentrum Almere, Upcycle Mall Rotterdam, SCRAP, Buurman Rotterdam and BlueCity. Part of the "Ohituskaista uudelleenkäyttöön" project.
projektit.html.case.lsjh.role: FinDera's role: designing the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, coordinating logistics, and acting as tour leader and interpreter.
projektit.html.case.se.desc: Transformation of energy companies: digitalisation, organisational change, future resilience and sustainability. The programme also included a board meeting.
projektit.html.case.se.role: FinDera's role: designing and scheduling the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, travel logistics, and acting as tour leader and interpreter.
projektit.html.case.ladec.desc: The mattress recycling value chain across two trips in the same year: the Netherlands in spring, Belgium and Germany in autumn.
projektit.html.case.ladec.role: FinDera's role: designing the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, coordinating logistics and providing remote support during the trip.
projektit.html.case.salpa.desc: The plastics recycling value chain at board and management level — a knowledge base to support investment decisions.
projektit.html.case.salpa.role: FinDera's role: designing the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, coordinating logistics and providing remote support during the trip.
projektit.html.case.salaoja.desc: Getting to know companies and experts in the subsurface drainage field: drainage machine factories, research institutes, work sites and design-related locations.
projektit.html.case.salaoja.role: FinDera's role: designing the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, coordinating logistics, and acting as tour leader and interpreter.
projektit.html.case.ely.desc: Climate change adaptation measures: solutions for cities, agriculture and water management, including the IBA and Lossi projects.
projektit.html.case.ely.role: FinDera's role: designing the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, coordinating logistics, and acting as tour leader and interpreter.
projektit.html.case.osao.desc: Energy and recycling solutions for buildings: sorting on site, construction waste treatment technologies, a materials recycling plant, waste heat recovery, the "Eco-block", ESCO projects, and energy management and storage.
projektit.html.case.osao.role: FinDera's role: designing and scheduling the programme, identifying the sites, confirming visits and restaurants, travel logistics, and acting as tour leader and interpreter.
projektit.html.q.rr: FinDera found exactly the right full-scale vertical farming site in Belgium for the needs of our development project, and the visit gave us valuable hands-on knowledge. I have also taken part in other waste management site visits organised by FinDera, which have been highly successful occasions to network and get to know new technologies.
projektit.html.q.rr.role: Service and Development Director, Rosk’n Roll Oy Ab
projektit.html.q.lsjh: We have used FinDera's services several times, because Martin comes up with new, interesting site suggestions that were previously unknown to us. The best part is how effortless it is: we get expert content design and all the practical travel arrangements at the same time.
projektit.html.q.lsjh.role: Research and Development Manager, Lounais-Suomen Jätehuolto Oy
projektit.html.q.osao: The trip gave us practical information about new ways of working and new technologies, and broadened our perspectives and contacts. Martin knows how to build a whole in which expert content, smooth arrangements, cultural understanding and warm interaction support one another.
projektit.html.q.osao.role: Project Development Manager, OSAO Joint Municipal Authority
projektit.html.q.ladec: FinDera found us the most interesting sites across the whole value chain and handled the arrangements turnkey, very smoothly. The first trip was such a success that we decided to run a second one in the same year — and we recommend FinDera for similar benchmarking needs.
projektit.html.q.ladec.role: Business Developer, Lahti Region Development LADEC Oy
projektit.html.q.ely: Working with Martin Brandt and FinDera Consulting was very smooth and professional. Martin succeeded in assembling a high-calibre expert programme and an extensive network, through which participants gained valuable practical lessons and international perspectives on climate change adaptation solutions.
projektit.html.q.ely.role: Water Management Specialist, Southwest Finland Vitality Centre
projektit.html.q.salpa: FinDera built an excellent package at board level: relevant sites, well-prepared meetings and smooth arrangements. We gained a valuable knowledge base to support investment decisions, and the visits led to new openings for collaboration.
projektit.html.q.turkuamk: FinDera delivered the set of site visits very smoothly — the programme was well paced and its content matched our needs precisely. We gained a great deal of new, hands-on knowledge about stormwater and greywater solutions.
projektit.html.q.turkuamk.role: Senior Specialist / Project Manager, Sustainable Environment, Turku University of Applied Sciences
projektit.html.q.turkuamk2: FinDera is a long-standing and valuable partner for us, one that finds the sites and organisations matching our objectives across many project contexts: the sites and contacts have always been chosen purposefully, and the arrangements have without exception been well prepared. The cooperation has given us new networks and practical lessons we have been able to apply directly in our own work. We recommend FinDera to organisations looking for hands-on learning and networks in sustainability themes.
projektit.html.q.turkuamk2.role: Lecturer, Sustainable Environment, Turku University of Applied Sciences
projektit.html.cta.title2: What kind of package shall we build for you?
projektit.html.case.rr.more: Participants: the board and leadership team together with partner organisations, 49 people in all.
projektit.html.case.lsjh.more:
Participants: the trip was organised by Southwest Finland Waste Management (LSJH) as part of the Ohituskaista uudelleenkäyttöön reuse project. Alongside LSJH and its project partner the Sustainable Development Association / Turku Ekotori, the group included people from Turku University of Applied Sciences' Baltic2Hand and Circular Tiedepuisto projects, the cities of Raisio and Turku, the Helsinki Region Reuse Centre and retail companies.

What united the participants was a wish to find ideas and inspiration for building reuse more firmly into their own organisations' projects and everyday work.

Sites: UpcycleCentrum Almere, De HER – Upcycle Mall Rotterdam, SCRAP, Buurman Rotterdam and BlueCity. What they had in common was the strong commitment of the people and companies running them to circular economy goals.

Read the trip report (PDF, in Finnish)
projektit.html.case.seinajoki.more:
Participants: members of the board and the leadership team, 15 people in all.

Main themes: digitalisation, organisational change and disruption, future resilience and sustainability. The programme also included a board meeting.
projektit.html.case.ladec.more:
Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them Salpakierto, LAB and Muovipoli. Eight people in all.

Two trips in one year: the Netherlands in spring 2024, and Belgium and Germany in autumn 2024, both of two days.
projektit.html.case.salpakierto.more: Participants: members of the board and the leadership team, 10 people in all. The programme also included a board meeting.
projektit.html.case.salaoja.more:
Participants: the association's executive director and representatives of member companies, 16 people in all.

Sites: subsurface drainage machinery plants, research institutes, and construction and design sites.
projektit.html.case.ely.more:
Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them MTK, the Baltic Sea Action Group, AFRY, Vaisala and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Sixteen people in all.

Content: practical solutions and models of cooperation in urban, agricultural and water management adaptation. The trip was delivered within the IBA and Lossi projects.
projektit.html.case.osao.more:
Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them Lassila & Tikanoja, VTT, Micropolis, Lapland UAS and OAMK. Twenty people in all.

Content: sorting and recycling on construction sites, construction waste treatment technologies, a building materials recycling plant, waste heat recovery and use, an ”eco-block” with its own power and heat generation and smart control, ESCO projects, and energy management and storage.

Background: the trip was planned jointly with the ERDF-funded Energiaratkaisut 2020 and Teolliset symbioosit Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla projects and Micropolis in Ii.

minusta.html.meta.title: Martin Brandt — FinDera Consulting
minusta.html.meta.desc: Martin Brandt is a sustainability and circular economy consultant who has been building connections between Finnish and European organisations since 2006.
minusta.html.ph.title: Martin Brandt — FinDera
minusta.html.ph.lead: I combine experience, networks and hands-on delivery so that your project or business can grow sustainably and successfully.
minusta.html.about.title: At the pulse of sustainable solutions.
minusta.html.about.lead: Since 2006 I have helped create hundreds of connections related to sustainability and foreign trade — in business management, project management and consulting roles.
minusta.html.about.p1: Working in the public and private sectors as well as in central government sustainability has given me a deep understanding of what different actors need in Finland and internationally — particularly in energy, the circular economy and environmental technology solutions more broadly.
minusta.html.about.p2: I have created hundreds of new connections between organisations and, through them, an extensive personal network in Finland and across Europe. I have also lectured at Aalto University and Åbo Akademi, among others.
minusta.html.about.p3: Broad experience means I can recognise workable solutions and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you — ensuring that every encounter is high in quality, smooth and worthwhile.
minusta.html.career.title: Perspectives from every side.
minusta.html.career.lead: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties — I have been, in turn, the client, the deliverer and the broker.
minusta.html.career.1.title: German-Finnish Chamber of Commerce
minusta.html.career.1.desc: As project director I delivered projects and trips for the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs relating to energy, the circular economy and export cooperation.
minusta.html.career.2.title: Valonia
minusta.html.career.2.desc: Project director at the Southwest Finland service centre for sustainable development and energy, working at the interface between municipal and business collaboration.
minusta.html.career.3.title: Sweco Finland Oy
minusta.html.career.3.desc: Circular economy development and project manager on the infrastructure side, working directly with clients. Among other things I drew up master plans for circular economy areas.
minusta.html.career.4.title: Motiva Services Oy
minusta.html.career.4.desc: Business manager at the commercial subsidiary of Motiva Oy, the Finnish state's affiliated sustainability body.
minusta.html.career.5.title: Findera Consulting
minusta.html.career.5.desc: I have helped a large number of Finnish companies into German-speaking markets in particular, and created over 100 business connections. Alongside that I have delivered more than 70 study and benchmarking trips.
minusta.html.stats.langs: working languages: Finnish, German and English
minusta.html.style.title: A human touch, a professional delivery.
minusta.html.style.1.title: Approachable
minusta.html.style.1.desc: I know how to meet people. Clients tell me I am approachable, easy to talk to and pleasant company for all participants.
minusta.html.style.2.title: Cultural understanding
minusta.html.style.2.desc: Years of German-Finnish cooperation have taught me how two working cultures are brought together. On trips I also act as interpreter — of the language and of the way things are done.
minusta.html.style.3.title: Effortless for the client
minusta.html.style.3.desc: I handle the whole so that participants can focus on what matters: schedules, logistics and finding the right people are my responsibility.
minusta.html.cta.title3: Shall we talk about what you are aiming for?
minusta.html.about.p0a: I am Martin Brandt, the founder of FinDera Consulting. FinDera grew out of hands-on work with sustainable solutions, sustainable development and international connections.
minusta.html.about.p0b: My background spans several kinds of stakeholder. I have worked on sustainability from a number of different vantage points over my career, which gives an unusually complete picture of what the different players need and what actually works in practice.
minusta.html.about.p4: This background is what FinDera is built on. I find the right players and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you. I open doors, confirm the meetings and shape the encounters so that they produce learning and collaboration.
minusta.html.footer.tagline: Circular economy and sustainability consulting, and study and benchmarking trips across Europe.

yhteystiedot.html.contact.intro: Call or send an email — often a short call is the fastest way to find out whether this is useful for you.
